name: Supermarkets (multiple)
note: Chain supermarkets, open Sundays. Full outdoor and bike shops in town. Best gear town on the western half — sort cold-weather kit here, not Cedar City.

name: Supermarkets (multiple)
note: Last full-service town before the high plateaus. Open Sundays. Outdoor shop and bike shop in town.

name: Joe's Main Street Market
note: First real grocery since Cedar City. CLOSED SUNDAYS. Sources disagree on the opening hour (7:00 / 7:30 / 8:00) — call ahead.

name: Ruby's Inn General Store
addr: 26 S Main St, Bryce Canyon City, UT 84764
note: Large general store, tourist pricing, open 7 days — which makes it the Sunday fallback in a stretch where everything else shuts.

name: Griffin's Grocery & General Merchandise
note: The bigger of Escalante's two groceries and the last real one for ~285 mi. CLOSED SUNDAYS.

name: Escalante Mercantile & Natural Grocery
note: Smaller, natural-foods leaning, closes earlier. Also CLOSED SUNDAYS. Post office in town is the smart mail-drop for the eastern half.

name: Hills & Hollows Market
note: Small but genuinely useful, and open 7 days. A meal and a partial top-up, not a resupply.

name: Burr Trail Grill
note: Seasonal and short hours. Do not plan a day around it.

name: Chuckwagon General Store (Austin's)
note: ~9 mi off route and worth it. Bakery/deli plus groceries, open 7 days. Best food between Escalante and Blanding, and the last before the Hwy 95 void.

name: Royal's Foodtown
note: NOTE: this is in Loa, ~13 mi past Torrey — often mislabelled as Torrey's store. Bigger than the Chuckwagon but a real detour, and closed Sundays.

name: Hollow Mountain
note: Gas station and convenience store built into the rock. Open 7 days, which matters because this is the load before 110 mi of nothing. Listed hours vary by source and one listing was self-inconsistent — call.

name: Duke's Slickrock Grill
note: Hot meal before the Hwy 95 stretch. Seasonal hours.

name: Hite Outpost — CLOSED
note: Store, fuel, ranger station and marina all closed 'until further notice' per NPS. Older route notes still list this as a resupply. THEY ARE WRONG.

name: Visitor Center
note: NO FOOD SOLD. Potable water at the VC is the only reliable water in a long dry stretch — and it is shut off after the first hard freeze. Call before you rely on it.

name: Clark's Market
note: ~14 mi off route. The supermarket that breaks the Hwy 95 carry — and it is CLOSED SUNDAYS. Arriving Sunday after a 110 mi carry is the classic mistake.

name: Blue Mountain Foods
note: Full grocery, laundry and motels in town. CLOSED SUNDAYS. A second listing gives (435) 587-2727 — try both.

name: City Market & others
note: Full supermarket, open Sundays. Multiple bike shops — best on the route. Fix everything here; nothing comparable until Durango.

name: Wild Gal's Market
note: Real groceries and produce. NOTE THE MONDAY CLOSURE and the late 10am opening — this is not a dawn-departure resupply.

name: Naturita Sales
note: Gas, deli, pizza slices, convenience goods. Open 7 days with long hours — the reliable backstop when Wild Gal's is shut.

name: Mesa Rose Kitchen + Grocery
note: Small grocery section plus coffee and a rotating menu. I could not confirm phone or hours from a reliable source — treat as unverified and have a fallback. The Divide Restaurant is the other option in town.

name: Supermarket & bike shops
note: ~13 mi off route and a descent you must climb back out of. Worth it only for a bike shop or a weather bail-out. Open Sundays.

name: Rico cafe / small store
note: A hot meal on the cold side of Lizard Head Pass if you are lucky. Do not plan food around it.

name: Full services
note: Eastern terminus. Supermarkets, bike shops, train, airport.
